import hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from jaeger_agent_omni.node_registry import discover,validate_profiles
root=Path("jaeger_agent_omni/nodes")
records=[]
for node in ("jaegeromni-41m-medium","jaegeromni-41m-converse"):
 manifest=json.loads((root/node/"node.json").read_text())
 path=root/node/manifest["adapter"]["path"]
 sha=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 assert sha==manifest["adapter"]["sha256"],node
 with np.load(path,allow_pickle=False) as z:
  records.append({"node":node,"adapter_sha256":sha,"sha_matches_manifest":True,"architecture":bytes(z["arch"]).decode(),"parameter_count":sum(z[k].size for k in z.files if "." in k),"declared_encoder_sha256":manifest["encoder"]["weights_sha256"]})
nodes=discover(root)
profiles=validate_profiles(root,nodes)
result={"scope":"CPU checkpoint identity and registry; no model inference; encoder hashes read from manifests", "nodes":len(nodes),"profiles":len(profiles["profiles"]),"checkpoints":records}
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
